settings.heading: SaunaSpace® 10‑Year Warranty — Infrared Saunas, Therapy Lights & Components

settings.content:
Because products made with care should come with a promise you can count on.

At SaunaSpace®, we believe caring for yourself should feel safe, supportive, and enduring. That’s why the infrared saunas, therapy lights, and handmade wellness tools we craft are backed by our 10-year warranty (and 5-year for SilverLining™ and FireLight® Bulb).

We build each product with uncompromising quality—because your investment in wellness deserves to last. While we hope you never need it, our promise is here just in case: thoughtful protection, from our hands to yours.

How It Works

In the unlikely event that your SaunaSpace product breaks down, we'll cover the cost of repairs during the course of
your warranty. You only pay shipping.
Contact hello@sauna.space and tell us about the problem.
Once we get your items, we'll repair or replace them in 5 to 15 business days.

10-Year Warranty

  • FireLight® Infrared Sauna
  • Hearth™ Infrared Sauna Panel
  • Glow Infrared Therapy Light
  • Glow Desk Arm
  • Glow Soft Case
  • Sauna Enclosure Kit
  • Sauna Cover Set
  • Shower Sauna Conversion Kit
  • Hearth™ Pedestal
  • Sauna Stool

Bulb Replacement Policy

  • All FireLight® Bulbs used in SaunaSpace products come with a 5-year warranty.
  • After 5 years, SaunaSpace customers with a Glow, Hearth or Sauna can replace bulbs for just $95 each, our exclusive loyalty rate.
  • For all other uses of FireLight® Bulbs, warranty is limited to 1 year.

settings.title: Warranty By Product
settings.footnote: *Warranty applies to FireLight® Bulbs when used as intended in SaunaSpace products. For any other uses of FireLight® Bulbs outside of SaunaSpace products (like the Glow, Hearth and FireLight Sauna), the bulb warranty is limited to one year. When you make a warranty claim, SaunaSpace may ask for proof of purchase of accompanying SaunaSpace products before processing the claim.

Warranty Information

SaunaSpace recognizes that certain naturally varying materials such as wood, cotton, bamboo, and glass used in its Products (hereafter referred to as “Products”) have naturally occurring blemishes, minor imperfections, weave asymmetry. These naturally occurring irregularities are not considered defects in materials for the purpose of this warranty, providing they do not adversely affect the functionality of the Product.

SaunaSpace warrants to the original consumer purchaser that its Products will be free from defects in materials and workmanship appearing under normal individual consumer use for each respective Product as set forth in the Warranty by Product chart above. SaunaSpace provides no warranty for any Product, part, or item not listed in the above Warranty by Product chart.

This warranty does not cover damage to Products caused by abuse, acts of God, mishandling, unauthorized repair, or your failure to consult a licensed health care provider regarding proper use of this Product.

THIS WARRANTY IS IN LIEU OF ALL OTHER EXPRESS WARRANTIES; AND ANY IMPLIED WARRANTIES, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO ANY IMPLIED WARRANTY OF MERCHANTABILITY OR FITNESS FOR PARTICULAR PURPOSE, ARE LIMITED TO THE DURATION OF THIS WARRANTY. IN NO EVENT WILL SAUNASPACE® BE LIABLE FOR ANY INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES.

Some states do not allow limitations on how long an implied warranty lasts and/or the exclusion or limitation of incidental or consequential damages, so the above limitation and/or the above exclusion may not apply to you. This warranty gives you specific legal rights, and you may also have other rights which vary from state to state. As its sole responsibility and your sole remedy for any warranted defect, SaunaSpace® will repair or replace any defective part of its Products, containing a warranted defect, free of charge, and with notification within a reasonable period of time (but no longer than 6 months) following the discovery of such defect.
